calendar_capacity_integration_method: month-end capacity effective at next-day start; daily linear interpolation; trapezoidal integral over 2024 leap year
profile_year_normalization: The supplied source profile is an 8760-hour non-leap model year; full-load hours are therefore divided by 8760 for the model target.
generation_and_utilization_source_title: National Energy Administration, 2024 national renewable-energy power development monitoring and evaluation results
scientific_scope_note: National total-wind anchor used only for a monotonic level correction of the onshore-wind proxy. It is not province-specific validation and does not imply that the national statistic excludes offshore wind.
